title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 (LLMRisks Archive)
excerpt: LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection ... LLM05:2025 Improper Output Handling

title: LLM01:2025 Prompt Injection
excerpt: A Prompt Injection Vulnerability occurs when user prompts alter the LLM's behavior or output in unintended ways.

title: LLM05:2025 Improper Output Handling
excerpt: Improper Output Handling refers specifically to insufficient validation, sanitization, and handling of the outputs generated by large language models before they are passed downstream to other components and systems.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
excerpt: the Core is composed of four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE. Each of these high-level functions is broken down into categories and subcategories.

title: AI RMF 1.0 - MEASURE function (Section 5.3)
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
excerpt: The MEASURE function employs quantitative, qualitative, or mixed-method tools ... to analyze, assess, benchmark, and monitor AI risk ... It uses knowledge relevant to AI risks identified in the MAP function and informs the MANAGE function.

title: AI RMF 1.0 - Accountable and Transparent (Section 3.4)
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
excerpt: the characteristics of trustworthy AI systems, which include valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy enhanced, and fair with their harmful biases managed.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
excerpt: Confabulation: The production of confidently stated but erroneous or false content (known colloquially as "hallucinations" or "fabrications") by which users may be misled or deceived.

title: AI 600-1 GenAI Profile - Information Integrity risk & content provenance actions
organization: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology)
excerpt: Verify GAI system training data and TEVV data provenance, and that fine-tuning or retrieval-augmented generation data is grounded. (Information Integrity, action MS-2.5-006)

title: Structured model outputs (OpenAI API)
excerpt: Structured Outputs is a feature that ensures the model will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema, so you don't need to worry about the model omitting a required key, or hallucinating an invalid enum value.

title: Vector embeddings (OpenAI API)
excerpt: An embedding is a vector (list) of floating point numbers. The distance between two vectors measures their relatedness. Small distances suggest high relatedness and large distances suggest low relatedness.

title: How tool use works (Claude Platform Docs)
excerpt: When Claude decides to use one of your tools, the API response contains a tool_use block with the tool name and a JSON object of arguments. Your application extracts those arguments, runs the operation ... and sends the output back in a tool_result block.
